e.title: ActEval
e.summary: 非寿险定价模型评估工具（PyPI acteval-insurance）：预测数组的多维评估——校准/判别/尾部风险/财务决策
e.body: ActEval 评估预测数组（而非拟合模型对象）的多个维度：精度、校准、判别力、概率质量、不确定性、观测尾部风险与财务决策影响——兼容 GLM、scikit-learn、XGBoost、CatBoost、神经网络等任意建模栈。设计目标：非寿险定价工作流，保持精算目标分离（不做武断的通用模型分数）——低 RMSE 的模型可能聚合校准更差、大额损失行为更弱、定价后果更不利，ActEval 让这些权衡显性化。对 RIAA：精算定价模型评估的正确打开方式。与 [[insurance-governance]]（模型治理）、[[machine-learning-pricing]] 互补。关联 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[claim-frequency]]。

e.summary_en: Non-life pricing model evaluation tool (PyPI acteval-insurance): multi-dimensional evaluation of prediction arrays — calibration/discrimination/tail risk/financial decisions
e.summary_hk: 非壽險定價模型評估工具（PyPI acteval-insurance）：預測數組的多維評估——校準/判別/尾部風險/財務決策
e.body_en: ActEval evaluates prediction arrays (not fitted model objects) across accuracy, calibration, discrimination, probabilistic quality, uncertainty, observed-tail risk and financial decisions — working with outputs from GLMs, scikit-learn, XGBoost, CatBoost, neural networks or any modelling stack. Designed for non-life insurance pricing: actuarial objectives stay separate, with no arbitrary universal model score — a model with lower RMSE can still have worse aggregate calibration, weaker large-loss behaviour or a less favourable pricing consequence; ActEval makes those trade-offs explicit. For RIAA: the right way to evaluate actuarial pricing models. Complements [[insurance-governance]] (model governance) and [[machine-learning-pricing]]. Related: [[actuarial-pricing]], [[claim-frequency]].
e.body_hk: ActEval 評估預測數組（而非擬合模型對象）的多個維度：精度、校準、判別力、概率質量、不確定性、觀測尾部風險與財務決策影響——兼容 GLM、scikit-learn、XGBoost、CatBoost、神經網絡等任意建模棧。設計目標：非壽險定價工作流，保持精算目標分離（不做武斷的通用模型分數）——低 RMSE 的模型可能聚合校準更差、大額損失行為更弱、定價後果更不利，ActEval 讓這些權衡顯性化。對 RIAA：精算定價模型評估的正確打開方式。與 [[insurance-governance]]（模型治理）、[[machine-learning-pricing]] 互補。關聯 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[claim-frequency]]。
